summary: Issue #560 MMU-12 Redis namespace policy: intent-review spec_fidelity=pass consumed as given. ownership-registry.yml documents juli:<module>: policy with legacy allowlist; redisNamespaces register ratelimit, analytics KPI, material_analytics, and celery-* with owners; check_ownership_registry.py and check_redis_key_prefixes.py (--strict) pass; 14 unit tests pass. No runtime key renames. No reliability/security/observability/performance blockers.

criticalFindings.description: Intent-review smell (non-blocking): test_registry_documents_redis_key_policy overlaps test_registry_documents_juli_module_convention_and_legacy_allowlist in test_redis_key_prefixes.py (same futureConvention/allowlist assertions).
criticalFindings.suggestion: Optional: consolidate policy assertions into a shared helper or drop the narrower duplicate in test_ownership_registry.py.

criticalFindings.description: Best-effort AST scan only detects literal/f-string prefixes in *_key/*_prefix builders and KEY/PREFIX module constants; dynamic concatenation or non-key-builder contexts may evade detection (implementation artifact risk).
criticalFindings.suggestion: Track as known limitation until #556 wires CI; add targeted tests when new Redis consumers land.

criticalFindings.description: extract_prefix_hits returns empty hits on SyntaxError without surfacing the parse failure; a syntactically invalid file could be skipped silently.
criticalFindings.suggestion: Optional follow-up: log or fail when a scanned .py file does not parse.

criticalFindings.description: Default CLI (without --strict) exits 0 and prints WARN for unregistered prefixes; AC satisfied via --strict and unit tests but operators must use strict mode for gating.
criticalFindings.suggestion: Validate and local docs should always invoke check_redis_key_prefixes.py --strict until pr.yml wiring (#556).

criticalFindings.description: Intent-review convention note (non-blocking): prefix scanner not yet added to pr.yml; deferred to MMU-3 #556 per implementation artifact. Acceptable for #560 AC (local test/script fails).
criticalFindings.suggestion: Wire check_redis_key_prefixes.py --strict in architecture gates when #556 lands.
